patientResponse.title: patientResponse
patientResponse.description:
This output receives a structured text summary of the patient record from the Flow (e.g., Name, Date of Birth, Gender).

Use this response for the agent's internal understanding and context building — do not display it directly to the user if the user has already asked for a specific query or action related to the patient.

If the user has requested a specific action (e.g., coverage details), use the patientResponse to inform the agent's decision, then trigger the appropriate follow-up agent action without surfacing this response.

If no specific query or action is detected in the user’s message, display the patientResponse in a clear and well-formatted way to confirm the patient has been identified.

Ensure AccountId or any internal identifiers are not shown in the response under any circumstance.
